ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Retention_RM'
&& (not(isblank( Date_First_Customer_Contact_Attempt__c )) || not(isblank(Proposal_Created_Date__c))) && ( (ispickval(Service_Line_CAC_Retention__c, 'RM') && (isblank( RM_Volume_Cu_Ft__c) || isblank(Total_Boxes__c) || isblank(Outboxes_Cu_Ft__c))) )
|| (RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Retention_SH' && (not(isblank( Date_First_Customer_Contact_Attempt__c )) || not(isblank(Proposal_Created_Date__c)))&& (ispickval(Service_Line_CAC_Retention__c,'SHRED') && (isblank( Shred_Bins__c ) || isblank( Shred_Consoles__c )))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage:
Service Line: RM then Total Boxes, RM-Volume (Cu Ft) & Outboxes are required.
Service Line: Shred then Shred- Bins and Shred - Consoles are required.
